subject: CS364
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English coverage is excellent, featuring highly authoritative sources like Aswath Damodaran and Michael Porter. The Arabic coverage is also strong, with highly-viewed, relevant videos for most topics. One Arabic topic, 'Negotiating and Structuring the Deal', had no eligible candidates as all search results were in English. For 'The Due Diligence Process' in Arabic, an exception was made to the view count rule to ensure coverage.

coverage.note: No candidate met the 3000 view count gate; selected the highest-view video over 500 views.
All shortlisted candidates were in English, failing the language gate.

videos.title: Session 1: Introduction to Valuation
videos.filter_reason: This is a foundational lecture from the world's leading academic on valuation, making it the most authoritative and highly-viewed introduction available.

videos.title: Mergers and Acquisitions Due Diligence Explained
videos.filter_reason: This video is a highly-viewed, concise, and perfectly titled explainer that directly addresses the due diligence process in an M&A context.

videos.title: Merger & Acquisition (M&A) Deal Structures Explained
videos.filter_reason: This is an excellent, concise overview of M&A deal structures from a reputable channel, with a high view count confirming its quality and clarity.

videos.title: How to Conduct a Feasibility Study - Project Management Training
videos.filter_reason: With a very high view count, this video provides a clear, practical, and step-by-step guide on how to conduct a feasibility study.

videos.title: The Five Competitive Forces That Shape Strategy
videos.filter_reason: This video is an interview with Michael Porter himself, the creator of the model, making it the most authoritative and credible source possible.

videos.title: تقييم الشركات و المشاريع الريادية الناشئة Startup and Company Valuation
videos.filter_reason: This is a comprehensive and highly-viewed video that explains multiple methods for valuing companies, with a relevant focus on startups.

videos.title: الفحص النافي للجهالة وتطبيقه على الشركات  ، للتواصل 0555339986
videos.filter_reason: As the best available option, this video from a lawyer clearly explains the concept of due diligence and its application to companies.

videos.title: كيفية إعداد دراسة الجدوى لمشروع جديد في 5 خطوات
videos.filter_reason: This video is an outstanding choice due to its massive view count and clear, step-by-step format for preparing a feasibility study.

videos.title: أعمال - القوى التنافسية الخمسة لبورتر
videos.filter_reason: This is a concise, well-animated, and very popular explainer that effectively introduces Porter's Five Forces for market analysis.
